description: Somos ArquiSoft, un equipo enfocado en convertir retos complejos y datos abiertos en aplicaciones reales. Como Founder de la iniciativa y estudiante avanzado de Ingeniería de Sistemas, aporto experiencia en desarrollo full-stack, arquitectura de software y participación en múltiples hackathons (con reconocimientos previos en NASA Space Apps).
summary: Project Mission Condor is a 2.5D educational video game focused on space exploration and survival, which transforms complex aerospace engineering principles into an interactive experience. The player takes on a mission that begins at a base located in the Andean salt flats, where they must make critical decisions that determine the viability and success of their expedition. Through resource management, the repair of mechanical failures using torque tools, and the application of In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU) technologies, players experience the real-world challenges involved in designing and executing a space mission. The game incorporates references to actual NASA hardware and spacecraft—such as the SLS rocket and the Orion vehicle—presenting scenarios where mass, energy, and fuel are the deciding factors for survival. Mission Condor aims to make space engineering more accessible through decision-based learning.
details:
Current State of the Video Game (Developed Features):

The team successfully developed a functional 2.5D ecosystem that includes:

  • Interactive Customization Screen: Player name entry and pet assignment.
  • Initial Environment: A modeled environment based on the Salar de Uyuni's Andean space base.
  • NASA Spacecraft Integration: Integration and visualization of NASA's SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft.
  • Resource Management System: Interactive management of mass, energy, and fuel.
  • Mechanical Failure Repair Mechanics: Repair of mechanical malfunctions using torque tools during the storm at the Mars/Base Tari environment.
  • ISRU Science System on Europa: Ice extraction and the production of oxygen and fuel using In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU) technology.
  • Narrative and Physical Ending: A storyline and physical outcome determined by the rocket equation and mass limitations.
